text:
Changed src/libraries/Common/src/System/Net/Http/HttpHandlerDefaults.cs and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/dotnet-handoff-expect-continue-timeout.md.

Commit message:
The Quillmere object-storage gateway answers 100-continue only after a remote token check that takes 1.4-2.2 s; with 1 s the client sent the body anyway and uploads about to be rejected with 401 were sent in full first.

writes.docs/decisions/dotnet-handoff-expect-con:
# Why src/libraries/Common/src/System/Net/Http/HttpHandlerDefaults.cs holds this value

The Quillmere object-storage gateway answers 100-continue only after a remote token check that takes 1.4-2.2 s; with 1 s the client sent the body anyway and uploads about to be rejected with 401 were sent in full first.
